messages:
rex_marketing: Hey team, need a compact benchpack for the launch microsite. Goal: show live demo resiliency + perf story. Requests: burst pattern (short spikes), streaming with function calls, quantized vs fp16, coldstart recovery, and a single long-context probe. We need artifacts + a sanitized prompt pack for slides by EOD Monday. :spiral_calendar:

anya_runtime: Can you define spike shape and which models? Also do you want kernel timings?

rex_marketing: Spike: 20s ramp -> 40 RPS sustain -> 90s idle, repeat x2. Models: open-3b-quant, open-7b-quant, open-7b-fp16. Kernel timings optional; end-to-end plus per-token GPU-ms preferred. Include p50/p90/p95/p99 and function-call end-to-end latency.

devon_devx: Ill paste a tiny harness snippet for bursts + typing simulation. Use it to ensure streaming chunk behavior is realistic.

devon_devx: ```json
{
  "scenario":"burst_typing",
  "ramp_s":20,
  "sustain_s":40,
  "idle_s":90,
  "repeats":2,
  "target_rps":40,
  "typing_delay_ms_range":[30,100],
  "stream_chunk_ms":200,
  "function_call":true
}
```

anya_runtime: Good. We'll run a quick smoke on quantized variants tonight, then a full sweep tomorrow morning. Artifacts: perf.jsonl (per-request), metrics.csv (1s), sanitized_prompts.json, README.txt with exact CLI + env (CUDA/toolkit/driver). Example run:```bash
redwood-bench --model open-7b-quant --profile burst_typing --harness samples/burst_typing.json --out ./artifacts/3201234567 --concurrency 25
```

maria_eval: I'll prepare a 24-case function-call fidelity suite (schema checks + missing-arg detection) and a few long-context coherence checks. Ill output a pass/fail table with flagged prompt ids. ETA tomorrow 09:00 PT.

benchbot: Queued run rb-2026-3201234567-01 targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=burst_typing, expected=30m. Artifacts will upload to s3://redwood-bench/3201234567_01/.

anya_runtime: We'll also include a small heatmap comparing coldstart p99 vs warmed p99 per-variant and a tiny table of per-token GPU-ms averaged across chunk indices. If any quantized variant fails eval, flag here and marketing can fallback to 3b quant for the demo.

rex_marketing: Perfect  thanks. Please tag @rex_marketing and attach artifacts link when ready. If anything looks off on function-call fidelity, call it out early so we can adjust slide copy. :thumbsup:
